text:
aline (Docs): Opened a small PR to tighten up the LumenX-4B model card: explicit supported quant tags, corrected embed dim, two-row perf table (512/2048), and a short migration note for q4_0. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12567 cc @diego @mei @samir

diego (Eng ML): Quick bench numbers from perf cluster (a100x2): seq=512 fp16 -> 322 tok/s, seq=2048 fp16 -> 142 tok/s. On t4 q4_1: ~96 tok/s @512. Embed dim is 2048 (fixed). I'll attach CSV to the PR.

mei (Runtime): Runtime note: recommend runtime >=1.9 for best quant kernel selection. q4_0 frequently falls back to CPU on older drivers; docs should list supported quant tags: fp16, q4_1, q5 and explicitly discourage q4_0 for GPU. Also add troubleshooting: run `redwoodctl runtime show-version` and enable `--log-quant-fallback` for debugging.

samir (DevEx): Preparing tiny SDK snippets: python streaming generate with max_new_tokens, embed() with shard_hint and node example showing tokenization edge case. Will keep examples short and add a compatibility check snippet.

zoe (QA): Latency checks: p50 ~28ms/token (512 fp16), p95 ~70ms. For 2048 p50 ~62ms. On t4 q4_1 p50 ~100ms. Formatting perf table as requested: three rows (512 fp16, 2048 fp16, 512 q4_1).

aline (Docs): Two editorial asks before merge: 1) add explicit "Quant tags supported" list in compatibility section; 2) short migration bullet titled "If you're on q4_0" explaining upgrade path and linking runtime upgrade guide.

diego (Eng ML): Adding a one-line eval note: small quality drop with int8 on long-form summarization; reference promptset id promptset-2026-09-lumenx.

mei (Runtime): Also add an operational note for Private deploys: CPU fallback rehousing increases memory by ~30% and spikes latency during the move. Suggest short bullet under Operational considerations.

samir (DevEx): Pushed python snippets and a brief Node snippet showing `client.streamGenerate` naming. Left a comment about tokenization limits.

merge-bot (bot): PR #12567: lint OK, link-check OK, mdx build OK.

aline (Docs): Merging once the migration note and the operational memory figure are in. Thanks everyone! :white_check_mark:

aline (Docs): (post-merge) PR merged, scheduling for docs release v1.28. Will backport the embed-dim fix to legacy catalog page.
